task: Prevent stale synthetic weather records from being displayed
new_findings: Cached records need an explicit capture time before age can be validated.
failed_approaches: Checking only that the cache file existed accepted stale records.
successful_approaches: Compare captured_at with the configured maximum age and test with a fixed clock.

reusable_knowledge.title: Validate cached record age
reusable_knowledge.what_happened: A cache-existence check accepted a stale synthetic record.
reusable_knowledge.root_cause: The record had no capture time, so its age could not be validated.
reusable_knowledge.correct_approach: Store captured_at and compare it with the configured maximum age before reuse.
reusable_knowledge.prevention: Test fresh, boundary-age, and expired records with a fixed clock.
reusable_knowledge.verification: All three fixed-clock cache-age cases pass.
